task_statement: Before editing run `python -m unittest discover -s checks`; after repair rerun the same command successfully. Implement the six-stage inventory reconciliation pipeline in src/inventory according to all six docs/01-parse.md through docs/06-render.md contracts. Review each stage contract and track progress through parsing, validation, normalization, aggregation, selection and rendering; verify stages and end-to-end behavior. Preserve public signatures, docs, config, instructions and tests. If verify_task is available, use it for both test-suite runs.
